experiment_data.hypothesis: Code domain scorer confound control: Qwen-1.5B Code K*=2 uses same-family Qwen scorer. D060 Wikipedia showed Qwen scorer inflates AUC by +0.005~0.027. If Pythia-1.4B scorer yields K*=2 on same Qwen Code text, confirms K*=2 is text-intrinsic (not scorer artifact). If K*=1, Qwen Code K*=2 is partially scorer-driven, weakening domain ceiling claim. Cross-family scorer validation on existing exp_code_qwen1b5 depth 0-5 data.
experiment_data.notes: Code domain K*=2 confirmed scorer-independent. Pythia-1.4B scorer reproduces K*=2 on Qwen-1.5B Code text (same as Qwen self-scorer). AUC deltas vs original: 0v1 Δ=-0.031, 1v2 Δ=-0.019 (minor drop, Pythia slightly weaker feature extractor), 2v3 Δ=+0.001 (identical). Boundary transition 1v2→2v3 robust: 0.7197→0.5308, clear drop below θ=0.6. JSD pattern consistent: sharp collapse at depth 2→3. Combined with arXiv cross-scorer results (LLaMA/Mistral K*=3 preserved), confirms generational depth K* is a text-intrinsic property governed by domain complexity, not scorer choice.
